content:
The Supreme Court has clarified that stamp duty on mining leases should be calculated on the expected royalty payable under the lease rather than on the dead rent amount. 

The ruling provides greater clarity on the valuation of mining lease documents and is expected to influence how such agreements are assessed and registered by authorities across the country.

comment: The practical challenge will be aligning state registration practices and past assessments with this interpretation, especially where leases have long relied on dead rent calculations. Clear transition guidance will matter for stakeholders.
